description: Permanently deletes the specified saved account board when the user requests its removal. Requires explicit boards:delete authorization and personal ownership or organization owner/admin access; guest boards are unsupported. Read get_board first and pass its current revision. Deletion cancels active generation jobs and cannot be undone. A revision conflict requires reading the board again. Missing, already deleted or inaccessible boards return the same not_found error; this does not confirm that an earlier request succeeded. No requestId or replay receipt is supported.

boardId.description: Saved account board ID from list_boards or get_board. Deletion requires personal ownership or organization owner/admin access.

expectedRevision.description: Saved revision returned by get_board. A mismatch returns revision_conflict; read the board again before preparing a new operation.

name: delete_board
title: Permanently delete an account board
